questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.Amit made a ____ decision.
Select the correct HOMONYM of the underlined word.His distinctive gait made him easy to recognise from a distance.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.Rina has a _________ smile.
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.His ___________ skills in negotiation helped secure a favorable deal for the company during the challenging economic climate.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. I prefer drinking ___ coffee to ___ tea.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (no article, no article) है।

Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.Despite his idiosyncratic behaviour and eccentricities, the philosopher maintained a meticulous routine that astonished even the most consceintious scholars.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.P. Books, however, offer a depth of understanding and reflection that short-form content often lacks.Q. In the age of digital media, people are constantly exposed to bite-sized information through social platforms.R. questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (a, no article) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Public libraries have long been cornerstones of communities, offering a wealth of knowledge and resources for free. Beyond just books, libraries provide access to computers, Wi-Fi, meeting spaces, and a variety of programmes for all ages. This accessibility makes libraries crucial for individuals seeking to bridge the digital divide, gain new skills, or simply enjoy a quiet space to read or work.The rise of e-readers and online resources might seem like a threat to traditional libraries. However, libraries are adapting to the changing landscape. Many now offer digital collections of e-books and audiobooks, allowing patrons to access materials anytime, anywhere. Libraries also host workshops on digital literacy, helping individuals navigate the online world with confidence.Furthermore, libraries are increasingly becoming hubs for social interaction and community engagement. They host book clubs, author talks, and cultural events, fostering a sense of connection and belonging. Libraries also play a vital role in early childhood education, providing story times, educational resources, and a nurturing environment for young minds to explore and learn.In conclusion, libraries remain essential institutions in the 21st century. By offering a blend of traditional and modern resources, fostering social connections, and supporting education, libraries continue to empower individuals and communities to thrive.638Select an appropriate title for the passage.
options: The Benefits of E-readers and Online Resources
The Importance of Public Libraries in the Digital Age
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (The Importance of Public Libraries in the Digital Age) है।
